shortDescription: A full-featured smart remote for every Amazon Echo Show — with Alexa text commands, landscape keyboard, and a home screen widget.
fullDescription:
Echo Show Remote turns your iPhone, iPad, or Android device into a complete remote control for every generation of Amazon Echo Show.

FEATURES:
• Universal compatibility — works with Echo Show 5, 8, 10, 15, and 21
• Full smart-TV button layout: D-pad, media, volume, power, brightness, mic, camera, and more
• Alexa button — tap instead of speaking to send text commands directly to Alexa
• Landscape mode expands into a full QWERTY keyboard that retracts when you rotate back to portrait
• Personalize the background with your own photo, a solid color, or a dark gradient
• Home screen widget for instant one-tap access to Alexa, playback, and volume
• Haptic feedback for every button press
• Supports all iPhone, iPad, and Android phone and tablet screen sizes
• Dark theme designed to match the Echo Show aesthetic
